short: Count via the mass and the index

lean.name: Formalism.MainNotions.StandardLattice.ClassNumberFormula₂
lean.plain: Count via the mass and the index
lean.note: Under the stated splitting and size conditions, the number of genus classes is a mass times an index times $(T^k-1)^f$. The dependence on $T$ is what lets the dimension argument turn a required size of the space of forms into a lower bound on the auxiliary prime.
